jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.salary: $70,000–$100,000 base plus equity; only the very top of the range reaches Audrey's $100K target
jobs.why: The employer's active description emphasizes operational workflow design, SOPs, dashboard and metric reporting, process improvement, stakeholder coordination, and translating business problems into scalable processes. Audrey's Orion experience supports these through Salesforce requirements and workflow automation, process mapping, UAT, documentation and training, and earlier recurring media/finance reporting. The role is an early-career product/business operations bridge with 1–3 years requested. No healthcare operations or recruiting automation experience is attributed to Audrey.
jobs.gap: Customer-facing SaaS onboarding and independent implementation ownership are not established; neither are healthcare claims/revenue-cycle expertise or production SQL. On-site NYC and a $70K–$100K range make this a significant compensation and flexibility tradeoff.
missingKeywords: healthcare claims and revenue cycle operations
